claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, BNTX (a buprenorphine-derived opioid receptor antagonist) most plausibly kills cells through a non-selective cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress/cytotoxicity rather than opioid receptor-mediated signaling, since opioid receptors are not known to drive cancer cell viability.
